name: pr-review
description: Automated GitHub PR review: a setup step configures the target repo and coding standards, then /pr-review lists open PRs, delegates diff analysis to a reviewer agent, and lets you choose what to post as comments.

coding_standards_dir.title: Default coding standards folder
coding_standards_dir.description: Your personal default coding-standards file/folder, used by /pr-review-setup when a project doesn't have its own. Change later with /plugin configure.
